For each ranked task, record frequency, time/impact, consequences of a wrong
answer, available evidence, an example case, and what a good result contains.
Identify the minimum observations and unacceptable advice. Qualitative answers
are sufficient; no invented frequency, savings estimate or precision is needed.

Brad and the reviewer then record the chosen tasks and rationale, recipe/version,
source-family candidates, reviewer competence, required independent reviewer and
unresolved rights or evidence. Draft topics remain draft until this decision is
recorded. Neither this worksheet nor model-generated content supplies sign-off.
